corpus: every row in RuBQ_2.0_paragraphs.json; unmodified text, in source order, one anonymous folder; no invented reception dates (doc_dt null)
queries: every official test question with at least one unique paragraphs_uids.with_answer; original Russian text, no subsampling or use of dev/answers/related list for ranking
qrels: binary 1 only for manually marked paragraphs_uids.with_answer; assume 0 gain for other ids solely for metric, unknown answers excluded, no verified_empty claims
metrics: macro nDCG@10 (primary), Recall@10, Hit@10, MRR@10, wins/ties/losses on nDCG@10, counts of empty top10 on positives
paired_interval: percentiles of 10000 paired cluster resamples of test questions connected by a common supporting Wikipedia page, query-weighted; seed 20261121
entry: direct pinned SearchEngine.search; each own query encoder, shared fixed passage vectors; no training or selection using outputs
